limitations: Double requestAnimationFrame measures a paint opportunity, not compositor presentation.
Native results contain one successful fresh interaction per mode, not a stable distribution. A prior repeated merged focus sequence timed out.
Machine power state and background workload were not controlled.
Browser replay excludes native IPC and debounce.
Tinymist write-to-frame includes filesystem watching and uses a Canvas/SVG mixed client; do not divide its latency by replay latency.
The repeated-text fixture favors content deduplication; it is not a representative corpus.
Page scene definitions remain resident; page references are windowed, not the entire resource cache.
